{{Quote|Unidentified craft, you are entering Imperial space. Transmit clearance code and stand by to be boarded.|An [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]], to the ''Fallon'' as it approaches Blackfel|<ref name="Boba Fett is Dead 2" />}}
The '''Blackfel system''' was located in the [[Greater Plooriod sector/Legends|Greater Plooriod sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]]<ref name="Northern Dependencies" /> that contained [[Blackfel]],<ref name="Boba Fett is Dead 2">[[Blood Ties: Boba Fett is Dead 2|''Blood Ties: Boba Fett is Dead'' 2]]</ref> an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] training [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="Boba Fett is Dead 3">[[Blood Ties: Boba Fett is Dead 3|''Blood Ties: Boba Fett is Dead'' 3]]</ref> Circa [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] ran the Imperial patrol in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Blackfel, which consisted of at least four [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], aboard the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Fallon (shuttle)|''Fallon'']] to reach the moon's surface. While above the planet, Fett damaged his own [[Starship/Legends|ship]], allowing it to crash-land without receiving Imperial inspection.<ref name="Boba Fett is Dead 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Blackfel [[Star system/Legends|system]] first appeared without identification in [[Blood Ties: Boba Fett is Dead 2|''Blood Ties: Boba Fett is Dead'' 2]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] written by [[Tom Taylor]], pencilled by [[Chris Scalf]],<ref name="Boba Fett is Dead 2" /> and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 30]], [[2012]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54020/star_wars_blood_ties_-_boba_fett_is_dead_2012_2|text=Star Wars: Blood Ties - Boba Fett Is Dead (2012) #2}}</ref> It was first identified in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square M-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
